title: Lilac Embassy
description: Two long-breathed lines meet in E-flat. A third voice enters in the middle, at first answering quietly and then redirecting the harmony towards A-flat. It leaves before the reprise, whose final phrase is shared between the original two speakers.
technical_note: Sustain the upper RH line while the inner fingers carry a separate sentence. Keep that moving voice below the melody and hear the bass as another line. The full right hand remains within an octave; clear pedal at each marked release.

performance.note: Authored breathing, changing dialogue and independent voicing; no random timing.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
